data.explanation: This letter confirms your new gym membership (Mitgliedschaft). It starts on 1 January 2027, runs for a minimum of 12 months, and costs €34.00 per month. You can already train for free until it officially starts. After the minimum term, it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled monthly. To end it after the first year, notice must reach the gym one month before the minimum term ends — the app will show you the exact deadline. No action is needed right now unless you want to review or later cancel the contract.
